exercises.question: Which connector introduces a consequence? [¿Qué conector introduce una consecuencia?]
options: por eso [therefore]
porque [because]
debido a [because of]

exercises.sentence: Hay demasiados coches, __ hay más contaminación. (so) [There are too many cars, so there is more pollution.]
exercises.english: There are too many cars, so there is more pollution.
Because of the traffic, buses frequently arrive late.

sentences: Hay demasiados coches. [There are too many cars.]
Por eso hay más contaminación. [Therefore there is more pollution.]
Finalmente, algunos vecinos quieren reducir el tráfico. [Finally, some neighbours want to reduce traffic.]

exercises.question: Which expression introduces a cause? [¿Qué expresión introduce una causa?]
options: debido a [because of]
por eso [therefore]
de modo que [so that / therefore]

exercises.sentence: Hay mucho __ en la zona, de modo que algunos vecinos quieren mudarse. (noise) [There is a lot of noise in the area, so some neighbours want to move.]
exercises.english: There is a lot of noise in the area, so some neighbours want to move.
Public transport is limited, so many people use the car.

exercises.sentence: Hay demasiados coches, por eso hay más contaminación.
options: There are too many cars, so there is more pollution.
There are fewer cars, so there is less pollution.
There are too many buses, so the streets are empty.

exercises.sentence: Debido al tráfico, los autobuses llegan tarde con frecuencia.
options: Because of the traffic, buses frequently arrive late.
Because of the buses, traffic has disappeared.
Because of the traffic, buses always arrive early.

exercises.sentence: El transporte público es limitado, así que muchas personas utilizan el coche.
exercises.english: Public transport is limited, so many people use cars.

exercises.sentence: Hay mucho ruido en la zona, de modo que algunos vecinos quieren mudarse.
options: There is a lot of noise in the area, so some neighbours want to move.
There is little noise, so everyone wants to stay.
There is a lot of traffic, so the neighbours want to build a factory.
Debido al tráfico, llegan tarde con frecuencia. [Because of the traffic, they frequently arrive late.]
Debido de el tráfico, llegan tarde con frecuencia. [Due of the traffic, they frequently arrive late.]
Por eso al tráfico, llegan tarde porque. [Therefore the traffic, they arrive late because.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué problema causa el exceso de coches?

options: Aumenta la contaminación, por eso necesitamos reducir el tráfico. [It increases pollution, so we need to reduce traffic.]
Aumenta la contaminación, porque necesitamos reducir el tráfico. [It increases pollution, because we need to reduce traffic.]
Aumentaba la contaminación, porque por eso reducirá el tráfico. [Pollution was increasing, because therefore traffic will reduce.]
Hay demasiado ruido, así que quieren buscar una zona más tranquila. [There is too much noise, so they want to look for a quieter area.]
Hay demasiado ruido, porque quieren buscar una zona más tranquila. [There is too much noise, because they want to look for a quieter area.]
Hay demasiado ruido, así como quieren buscar una zona más tranquila. [There is too much noise, as well as they want to look for a quieter area.]

template.prompt: Describe one city problem and explain its consequence.
template.answer: Hay demasiado tráfico, por eso aumenta la contaminación y los autobuses llegan tarde porque creo que es importante para la comunidad.

template.prompt: Explain a problem using a cause connector.
template.answer: Debido al ruido, algunos vecinos quieren mudarse a una zona más tranquila porque creo que es importante para la comunidad.
